recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add redundant prose or edit generated diagrams for FHIR-40437; handle any future device-property terminology content changes under terminology-specific issues such as FHIR-49750 successors.
issue_request: FHIR-40437 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request raised against R4. It reported missing ValueSet links for Device.property.type and DeviceDefinition.property.type, and its resolution states that the problem was fixed in R5 with no further change required as a duplicate of applied FHIR-32567.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied through the FHIR-32567/FHIR-32286 work: 0d858aae58 added Device.property.type binding and the ValueSet, 0d21525adf corrected the ValueSet URL, and 2cfdd9c837 added the same binding to DeviceDefinition.property.type.
additional_context: Device and DeviceDefinition are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Current source has both affected property.type elements bound to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/device-property-type, and later FHIR-49750 cleanup replaced the old device-type example content while preserving the binding target. Zulip and OO Confluence minutes support the conclusion that the R4 link problem was already corrected in R5/current build source.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because the authoritative XML source already contains the requested links and the target terminology source exists.
